title: The Three Strays
description: Three fish have left their home waters this week, one after another. Each is a hunt of its own: the first angler to hook it takes that hunt's prize.

hunts.name: The Gilded Guest
hunts.description: A golden carp is feeding in the shallows. Any rod will do, and the pond is as good a place as any.

hunts.name: The Night Catfish
hunts.description: A wels catfish has come up from the deep. It can be met anywhere from the pond to the lake, and the lake is where it is at home.

hunts.name: The Wandering Bluefin
hunts.description: A bluefin tuna has strayed inland. It keeps to moving and deep water, and the open sea suits it best. Good tackle counts for the most here, and it still guarantees nothing.
